run_modify_caffe2_ftvideo: run the script to convert a Caffe2 classification model to a finetune model by removing prediction and momentum blobs
load_caffe2_cls_model: load a Caffe2 classification model file and convert it for finetuning by removing non-parameter fields
remove_spatial_bn_layers: remove spatial batch normalization layers and absorb their parameters into the preceding convolution layer
absorb_std_to_conv1: absorb input standard deviation into the conv1 weights for data preprocessing normalization
remove_momentum: remove momentum blobs from the model dictionary that are used for optimizer state
